Full details: Title check

**Explanation** The title names the main change: the Rails error context no longer includes the controller. It uses the conventional fix(rails) prefix and matches the changeset, which excludes :controller in the execution-context callback and ErrorSubscriber.report.
Full details: Description check

**Explanation** The description states the problem (Rails adds a redundant controller object to execution context), the fix (exclude :controller in both the callback and ErrorSubscriber.report), and the testing results. It is directly related to the changeset.
Full details: Linked Issues check

**Explanation** Issue `#755` asks that Honeybadger capture only user-provided context from Rails.error.set_context, without the Rails-added :controller key. The diff at the reviewed head applies `.except(:controller)` in two places in lib/honeybadger/plugins/rails.rb: the ActiveSupport::ExecutionContext.after_change callback (passed to Honeybadger.context) and ErrorSubscriber.report (passed as notify context). Both paths that carry the controller instance are covered. The PR description states that other context keys remain available and the source hash is not mutated. Hash#except returns a new hash, so the source context is not modified. The added spec file (spec/unit/honeybadger/plugins/rails_spec.rb, +55 lines per the summary) covers both paths with and without a controller, metadata retention, and source-hash immutability. I did not read the spec file contents; the test coverage claim rests on the summary and the PR description. The issue's optional configurable ignore list is explicitly deferred, so its absence is not a gap.
Full details: Out of Scope Changes check

**Explanation** All changed code is limited to the two Rails plugin context paths that carry the Rails execution context into Honeybadger notifications, plus the spec file that tests those paths. No unrelated files or behavior changes appear in the summary or in the lib/honeybadger/plugins/rails.rb diff. The spec file is supporting test coverage for the same change.
